source: Original syllabus-based practice questions; not an authentic UPSC PYQ

questions.q: Neither the cadets nor the instructor ___ willing to postpone the briefing.
questions.explanation: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject, instructor, which is singular.

questions.q: Each of the candidates ___ submitted the required certificate.
questions.explanation: Each is grammatically singular and takes has.

questions.q: Choose the correct completion: If the team ___ the warning earlier, it would have changed its route.
questions.explanation: A past unreal condition takes past perfect in the if-clause and would have plus past participle in the result clause.

questions.q: Choose the correct phrase: The rescue team acted ___ the instructions issued by the control room.
questions.explanation: The standard expression is in accordance with.

questions.q: Select the word closest in meaning to 'meticulous'.
questions.explanation: Meticulous means very careful and attentive to detail; thorough is the closest option.

questions.q: Select the antonym of 'scarce'.
questions.explanation: Scarce means in short supply; abundant means plentiful.

questions.q: To 'hit the nail on the head' means to:
options: Describe exactly what is causing a situation
questions.explanation: The idiom means to identify or state something exactly and accurately.

questions.q: A person who can use both hands equally well is:
questions.explanation: Ambidextrous describes someone able to use both hands with similar skill.

questions.q: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: Accommodation is spelt with double c and double m.

questions.q: Choose the correct word: The official was asked to be ___ about the sensitive discussion.
questions.explanation: Discreet means careful and tactful in speech or conduct.

questions.q: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The new officer is senior than me.
The new officer is senior to me.
The new officer is more senior from me.
The new officer is senior over than me.
questions.explanation: Senior is followed by to, not than.

questions.q: Choose the correct passive form of: 'The committee will announce the results tomorrow.'
options: The results will announce by the committee tomorrow.
The results will be announced by the committee tomorrow.
The results are announced by the committee tomorrow.
The committee will be announced the results tomorrow.
questions.explanation: The future passive uses will be followed by the past participle: will be announced.

questions.q: Choose the correct indirect speech: Mira said, 'I have completed the assignment.'
options: Mira said that I have completed the assignment.
Mira said that she had completed the assignment.
Mira says that she completed the assignment.
Mira said that she has complete the assignment.
questions.explanation: With a past reporting verb, the present perfect normally shifts to past perfect and the pronoun changes to she.

questions.q: Arrange the parts to form a coherent sentence: P. after the inspection was complete; Q. the team submitted its report; R. to the control room; S. with photographs and recommendations.
questions.explanation: The sentence reads: The team submitted its report to the control room with photographs and recommendations after the inspection was complete.

questions.q: Read the passage: 'A reliable institution earns confidence not through promises alone but through consistent decisions, transparent procedures and accountability when mistakes occur.' What is the central idea?
options: Institutions should avoid explaining their decisions.
Public confidence grows through consistency, transparency and accountability.
Promises are more important than procedures.
Mistakes should never be acknowledged publicly.
questions.explanation: The passage directly links public confidence to consistent action, transparent procedures and accountability.

questions.q: The dockyard associated with the Harappan civilisation was discovered at:
questions.explanation: Lothal in Gujarat is widely associated with a Harappan dockyard and maritime trade.

questions.q: Which ancient Indian scholar is traditionally associated with the work Aryabhatiya?
questions.explanation: Aryabhata composed the Aryabhatiya, a major work on mathematics and astronomy.

questions.q: The Champaran Satyagraha of 1917 was primarily associated with the grievances of:
questions.explanation: The movement addressed the exploitative conditions imposed on indigo cultivators in Champaran.

questions.q: Which Fundamental Right is protected by Article 21 of the Constitution?
options: Protection of life and personal liberty
Equality of opportunity in public employment
questions.explanation: Article 21 protects life and personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

questions.q: A Money Bill can be introduced in Parliament only in the:
questions.explanation: A Money Bill is introduced only in the Lok Sabha, on the President's recommendation.

questions.q: Which river flows westward through a rift valley before reaching the Arabian Sea?
questions.explanation: The Narmada follows a westward course through a rift valley and drains into the Arabian Sea.

questions.q: The retreating southwest monsoon is most closely associated with rainfall in Tamil Nadu during:
questions.explanation: Tamil Nadu receives much of its rainfall from the northeast or retreating monsoon in October and November.

questions.q: The SI unit of electrical resistance is the:
questions.explanation: Electrical resistance is measured in ohms.

questions.q: Which cell structure is the principal site of aerobic respiration and ATP production?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria carry out most aerobic respiration and generate much of a cell's ATP.

questions.q: The repo rate is the rate at which:
options: The Reserve Bank lends short-term funds to banks against eligible securities
Banks pay interest on savings accounts
questions.explanation: The repo rate is the policy rate at which the RBI provides short-term funds to eligible banks against securities.

questions.q: Gross Domestic Product measures the value of:
options: All intermediate goods produced by citizens anywhere
Final goods and services produced within a country's domestic territory during a period
Only exports sold by a country
Only government expenditure in a year
questions.explanation: GDP measures the market value of final goods and services produced within a country's domestic territory during a specified period.

questions.q: INS Arihant is best described as an Indian:
questions.explanation: INS Arihant is a nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine and part of India's sea-based nuclear deterrent.

questions.q: The ozone layer that absorbs much of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation is mainly in the:
questions.explanation: The ozone layer is concentrated in the stratosphere.

questions.q: The headquarters of the United Nations is located in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.q: In a food chain, green plants are generally classified as:
questions.explanation: Green plants produce organic matter through photosynthesis and form the producer level of most food chains.

questions.q: A number is increased by 20% and then decreased by 20%. What is the net change from the original number?
questions.explanation: The resulting factor is 1.2×0.8=0.96, so the final value is 4% below the original.

questions.q: The ratio of two numbers is 3:5 and their sum is 64. What is the smaller number?
questions.explanation: There are 8 equal parts, each worth 64/8=8; the smaller number is 3×8=24.

questions.q: The HCF of 84 and 126 is:
questions.explanation: 84=2×42 and 126=3×42, so their greatest common divisor is 42.

questions.q: A can complete a task in 12 days and B in 18 days. Working together at constant rates, they complete it in:
questions.explanation: Their combined daily rate is 1/12+1/18=5/36, so the time is 36/5=7.2 days.

questions.q: A train 150 m long passes a pole in 10 seconds. Its speed is:
questions.explanation: Speed is 150/10=15 m/s; multiplying by 3.6 gives 54 km/h.

questions.q: An article bought for Rs 800 is sold for Rs 920. The profit percentage is:
The simple interest on Rs 5,000 at 8% per annum for 2 years is:
questions.explanation: Simple interest is PRT/100=5000×8×2/100=Rs 800.

questions.q: If 3x−7=20, the value of x is:
questions.explanation: Adding 7 gives 3x=27, hence x=9.

questions.q: The roots of x²−7x+12=0 are:
questions.explanation: x²−7x+12 factors as (x−3)(x−4), so the roots are 3 and 4.

questions.q: The sum of the interior angles of a hexagon is:
questions.explanation: The sum is (n−2)×180=(6−2)×180=720 degrees.

questions.q: The circumference of a circle of radius 7 cm is (use pi=22/7):
questions.explanation: Circumference is 2πr=2×22/7×7=44 cm.

questions.q: The value of tan 45 degrees is:
questions.explanation: For a 45-degree angle, opposite and adjacent sides are equal, so tan 45 degrees=1.

questions.q: The area of a triangle with base 12 cm and perpendicular height 9 cm is:
questions.explanation: Area=1/2×base×height=1/2×12×9=54 cm².

questions.q: The mean of 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14 is:
questions.explanation: The sum is 50 and there are 5 values, so the mean is 10.

questions.q: A bag contains 4 red and 6 blue balls. One ball is drawn at random. The probability that it is red is:
questions.explanation: There are 4 favourable outcomes among 10 equally likely balls, giving 4/10=2/5.
